Abdallah Al-Fakhori.note: Al-Fakhouri stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Abdallah Al-Fakhori.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Abdallah Nasib.note: Nasib's edge is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Abdallah Nasib.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Mohammad Abu Alnadi.summary: Mohammad Abu Alnadi is a Jordanian centre-back for Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.note: Watch Alnadi for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Husam Abu Dahab.note: Watch Dahab for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Husam Abu Dahab.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Mohammad Abu Ghoush.note: Taha is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.note: Hashish's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohannad Abu Taha.note: Taha's edge is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Mohannad Abu Taha.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Mohammad Abu Zraiq.note: Zraiq stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Yazan Al-Arab.note: Watch Al-Arab for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Yazan Al-Arab.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mohammad Al-Daoud.note: Al-Daoud's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Ali Azaizeh.note: Azaizeh's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ali Azaizeh.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在用有目的的无球移动创造接应点上。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Ali Olwan.note: Watch Olwan for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ali Olwan.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Mahmoud Al-Mardi.note: Watch Mardi for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Noor Al-Rawabdeh.note: Watch Al-Rawabdeh for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mousa Al-Taamari.note: Al-Taamari is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Mousa Al-Taamari.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Amer Jamous.note: Jamous is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Amer Jamous.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Anas Badawi.note: Badawi stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Anas Badawi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Nour Bani Attiah.note: Attiah is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Nour Bani Attiah.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Ehsan Haddad.note: Haddad's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ehsan Haddad.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Ibrahim Sadeh.note: Watch Sadeh for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Ibrahim Sadeh.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Nizar Al-Rashdan.note: Al-Rashdan stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Odeh Fakhoury.note: Watch Al-Fakhouri for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Odeh Fakhoury.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Rajaei Ayed.note: Watch Ayed for creating a better angle for the next pass. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Rajaei Ayed.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Saed Al-Rosan.note: Al-Rosan stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Saed Al-Rosan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Saleem Obaid.note: Obaid's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Saleem Obaid.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yazeed Abulaila.note: Laila stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Yazeed Abulaila.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。
